title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Giving Full Play to the Role of Judicial Functions to Effectively Safeguard the Safety of Schools, Kindergartens, and Surrounding Areas
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Giving Full Play to the Function of Adjudication to Effectively Maintain Safety in and Around Schools and Kindergartens

Fa [2010] No. 193

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Recently, vicious cases of violent assault on primary and secondary school students and kindergarten children have occurred successively in Nanping, Fujian; Beihai, Guangxi; Zhanjiang, Guangdong; Taizhou, Jiangsu; Weifang, Shandong, and elsewhere, causing immense suffering to teachers, students, and families and creating a severe adverse social impact. Leaders of the Central Committee have paid close attention to this and have made important instructions in succession. General Secretary Hu Jintao pointed out: "Such cases cause immense social harm and must be taken very seriously. Criminals must be dealt with severely according to law. The injured must be treated with care. Campus safety inspections and precautions must be effectively strengthened. Strictly prevent the recurrence of such cases." The Central Committee also convened a special meeting to study and deploy this work. To implement the important spirit of the instructions of the leaders of the Central Committee and the arrangements of the Central Committee, the relevant work is hereby notified as follows:

1. Raise awareness and effectively enhance the sense of responsibility for maintaining safety in and around campuses and kindergartens. The current situation facing social stability work remains severe and complex. The five vicious cases that occurred consecutively in Nanping, Fujian, and four other places, targeting primary school students, kindergarten children, and teachers, have severely disrupted the educational order of schools and seriously affected social security and stability. People's courts at all levels must deeply understand the important spirit of the Central Committee's instructions, fully recognize the extreme importance and practical urgency of strengthening school and kindergarten safety, give full play to the function of adjudication, and effectively shoulder the political responsibility of maintaining school and kindergarten safety. They must take the maintenance of safety in and around schools and kindergartens as specific measures to deeply advance the three key tasks of resolving social conflicts, innovating social management, and ensuring fair and incorruptible law enforcement, and earnestly implement them.

2. Properly adjudicate and enforce all types of cases. People's courts nationwide shall, in accordance with the requirement of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," give full play to the function of adjudication in resolving conflicts and disputes and maintaining social stability, and adjudicate all types of cases fairly and efficiently according to law. They must severely punish all types of serious crimes, intensify the crackdown on crimes such as organized crime of a triad nature, drug crimes, and crimes against property that are strongly resented by the people, and enhance the people's sense of security. Adhere to the principle of "mediation first, combining mediation and adjudication," focus on achieving case closure and dispute resolution, and integrate mediation work into every link including case filing, adjudication, enforcement, appeal, and petition. Comprehensively strengthen mediation in criminal cases with civil collateral actions, reconciliation in minor criminal cases, mediation in civil cases, coordination in administrative cases, and reconciliation in enforcement cases, improve mediation efficiency, focus on mediation quality, and prevent and avoid the escalation of conflicts and disputes. Cases involving personal injury compensation on campus, juvenile delinquency, construction of school and kindergarten educational facilities, and other matters related to education and minors shall be properly handled, effectively protecting the physical and mental health of minors and maintaining good educational order.

3. Severely crack down on illegal and criminal activities that harm the safety of teachers and students according to law. For vicious criminal cases that have already occurred harming the safety of teachers and students, the people's court shall intervene in advance and become familiar with the case situation as soon as possible. Once the case enters the litigation procedure, the people's court must strictly comply with the Criminal Law, the Criminal Procedure Law, and other laws and judicial interpretations, strictly control the procedural, evidentiary, factual, and legal application gates, and promptly adjudicate and sentence according to law to deter crime and reassure the public. At the same time, the motives for the crime must be thoroughly investigated, the causes of such cases and the weak links in safety precautions must be deeply analyzed, and judicial suggestions must be timely submitted to local governments and relevant education administrative departments to improve the targetedness and effectiveness of prevention work.

4. Actively participate in comprehensive social security management. Actively rely on adjudication work to thoroughly investigate social conflicts from the adjudication and enforcement of various cases, promptly identify budding or trending issues that may affect social stability, and handle them properly according to law. Persist in providing follow-up assistance and education to persons sentenced to probation, control, or exempted from punishment, as well as persons released from prison or reeducation through labor, to prevent recidivism. Actively cooperate with relevant departments to resolve the practical difficulties of persons released from prison or reeducation through labor. Strengthen and standardize the work of executing sentences outside prison, deeply advance the pilot work of community correction, and give full play to the important role of community correction in educating and reforming criminals and preventing recidivism. People's courts at all levels must deeply analyze the causes and lessons of vicious cases occurring in schools and kindergartens, carefully summarize patterns and characteristics, and, as needed, go into schools and kindergartens to conduct legal education to enhance safety awareness, self-protection ability, and legal awareness. Actively participate in social stability risk assessment activities organized by Party committees and governments, strengthen the construction of a stability risk assessment mechanism for their own work, and when issuing judicial policies, adjudicating or enforcing cases involving the interests of the majority, conduct risk assessments in advance to prevent problems affecting social stability due to improper work.

5. Unblock channels for communication with public opinion. Through various effective means, extensively listen to and carefully analyze opinions and suggestions from all sides on the work of the people's court, and timely formulate and implement corrective measures. Continuously improve mechanisms and systems for ensuring judicial democracy, broaden the channels, scope, and methods of communication with public opinion, and orderly expand public participation in judicial activities. Promote activities such as judges entering neighborhoods, communities, schools, factories, and mines, earnestly listen to the demands of the people, promptly grasp social conditions and public opinion, promptly resolve those demands that are reasonable and lawful, patiently explain those demands that do not conform to laws and policies, actively assist in resolving the practical difficulties of those who are truly in need, and pay attention to educating and guiding those with emotional grievances. Resolutely prevent extreme incidents caused by the escalation of conflicts due to improper work attitude or methods.

6. Strengthen organizational leadership. People's courts at all levels must conscientiously implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, correctly handle the relationship between reform, development, and stability, and provide legal guarantees for maintaining the normal teaching order of schools and kindergartens through strict and fair adjudication activities. Presidents of people's courts at all levels must effectively assume leadership responsibility, strengthen the division of responsibilities, improve work plans, and properly handle all types of cases involving safety and stability in and around schools and kindergartens according to law. For major vicious cases endangering schools and kindergartens that occur due to lack of attention to work, ineffective organization, or inadequate guarantees, the relevant leaders and personnel shall be held accountable.

Any problems encountered during the implementation of this notice shall be promptly reported to our Court.

May 10, 2010
